values.quote: the second strike dealing {{as|50% AD}} {{as|physical damage}}
generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Double Strike'' for 4 seconds

values.meaning: stacks required to trigger second strike
values.binNote: Wiki says 3 stacks trigger the second strike, but MasterYiPassive.AttackCount = 4 in the bin. This is a real disagreement, not a units mismatch; the bin's AttackCount does not carry the wiki's 3.

mechanics.claim: Basic attacks generate a stack of Double Strike on-hit, refreshing on subsequent hits.
mechanics.quote: basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Double Strike'' for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits

mechanics.claim: At 3 stacks, the next attack is empowered to strike twice, consuming the stacks on-hit.
mechanics.quote: At 3 stacks, '''Master Yi's''' next basic attack {{tip|on-attack}} is empowered to consume the stacks {{tip|on-hit}} and strike twice

mechanics.claim: The second strike applies on-hit effects, triggers on-attack effects, and can critically strike separately from the first strike.
mechanics.quote: The second strike separately rolls a {{tip|critical strike}}.

mechanics.claim: Double Strike does not cause two full attacks; effects that trigger on completing the attack windup only trigger once.
mechanics.quote: ''Double Strike'' does not cause '''Master Yi''' to attack twice. Effects that trigger on completing the attack windup will only trigger once

mechanics.claim: The second strike itself can generate a stack for the next Double Strike activation.
mechanics.quote: the second strike applies on-hit effects, the second strike is able to add a stack for the next ''Double Strike'' activation

mechanics.claim: Attacks that are dodged, blocked, or missed while blinded do not generate or refresh stacks.
mechanics.quote: Basic attacks that are {{tip|dodge|dodged}}, {{tip|block|blocked}}, or missed while '''Master Yi''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}} will not generate any stacks of ''Double Strike'' nor refresh the duration of active stacks.
